proposal.title: Demo City accessible transit corridor
proposal.description: Seeded demonstration proposal for accessible bus corridor stops serving commuters in the high-need district.

candidates.label: OVERLAPPING
candidates.reasoning: Both initiatives serve commuters in the same demo district and period; coordinate corridor scope and procurement.

candidates.label: COMPLEMENTARY
candidates.reasoning: The feeder-route accessibility work reinforces the proposal without duplicating its corridor outputs.

memo.summary: Coordination recommendation only: co-finance compatible corridor components and focus coordination discussion on the high-need district; this does not allocate or move funding.
